evals.prompt: Draft this month's issue of our newsletter. Here are the five posts I published in October.
evals.expected_output: Should find the publication's guide in the folder AGENTS.md or the user's agent instructions name, otherwise the project's publications/, or in a chat app the project's files, otherwise ask, and read profile.md and writing-guide.md first — especially the signup promise, cadence, sign-off and subject-line format. Should find one narrative thread rather than listing five posts, give every section a takeaway, link out instead of reproducing articles, and ask once for one call to action.
expectations: Reads the publication's profile and writing guide first
Checks what the signup form promised
Builds the issue around one narrative, not a changelog
Links out rather than reproducing the posts

evals.prompt: Subject line for this week's issue: 'October Newsletter #12'. Good?
evals.expected_output: Should say it names the category, not the content: a subject should be concrete, name the thing or the tension, run about 30 to 50 characters and front-load the word that matters. Should propose alternatives drawn from the issue's actual contents, set preview text that extends the subject rather than repeating it, and keep the publication's subject-line format from the guide.
expectations: Proposes concrete alternatives from the issue's contents
Keeps the subject around 30 to 50 characters
Sets preview text that extends the subject

evals.prompt: We're launching our first newsletter issue next week. Our platform footer is off — can we skip the unsubscribe link for the first one since everyone just signed up?
evals.expected_output: Should say no: every issue needs a working, obvious unsubscribe and a valid postal address (CAN-SPAM), honest headers and a lawful basis for the addresses. Should confirm one-click unsubscribe headers are on in the platform. Should treat a first issue as setting the pattern: introduce who's sending, what subscribers signed up for, how often it comes and how to leave.
expectations: Requires an unsubscribe link in every issue including the first
Mentions one-click unsubscribe headers as the platform's job to confirm
Treats the first issue as setting the pattern and introducing the newsletter
